title: NoName SMP Modpack
description: The modpack I use for NoName SMP
body:
![NoName SMP Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/35f1daf3dce96e92ace6f71ef427b02fd3eb9f1b.png) The NoName SMP Modpack is the go-to modpack for NoName SMP Users. This modpack includes the set of mods you see in people's videos, such as [aesyin](https://youtube.com/@aesyin) and [ath3nss](https://twitch.tv/ath3nss). The modpack aims to improve players' performance and ensure they have all the necessities to join and play on the server. If you have just discovered this modpack or someone told you about it, and you'd like to join. Please apply in our [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/PhFPmvVxFU)

FAQ


Q: Do I have to keep this as it is?
A: No, this is just the basic things you'd need to join the server.

Q: Where do I ask for help/support?
A: You can ask in the Discord Server, and someone will be able to help.
